sensoryProfile.sight: A ridge with a ridge path, a slope of waist-high ferns and bracken falling to a stream, a leaning ash and a boulder forming a gap, jays in the branches, tree line across the hollow
sensoryProfile.sound: Quarrelling jays, a stream heard but unseen, birdsong returning after the kill (finch, jays)
sensoryProfile.smell: Rank coppery troll blood cutting through resin and sun-warmed Eversong blossom
sensoryProfile.touch: Damp bracken soaking leathers at knees and elbow; moss-slick roots underfoot
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Windy morning, sunlit; tension of a closing hunt, then relaxed stalling

establishedFacts.fact: Eight Amani trolls were taken in the sweep: four on the ridge path, four down (three lay dead on the ridge at Sylvanas's back; the last ran for the stream).
The last troll broke from the ash side of the gap with a throwing axe; Sylvanas shot him under the arm as his left foot slipped on a moss-slick root.
Lor'themar ordered the bodies burned before something with a nose found them.
Patrol watered horses upstream of the troll body.
It was barely past mid-morning at the end of the hunt; Silvermoon is a day's ride (dusk arrival).

eventsHere.event: Final kill of the Amani sweep; Sylvanas proposes checking the ward-stones to the south.
